name: MeloNX
subtitle: Nintendo Switch emulation for iOS, from the official MeloNX releases
description:
MeloNX is an open-source Nintendo Switch emulator for iPhone and iPad,
built on Ryujinx and written in C# and Swift.

**This is an unofficial community source.** It only mirrors the .ipa files
published on the official MeloNX releases page; it does not host, modify or
repackage anything.

Requirements:
- MeloNX **requires JIT** and cannot run without it (e.g. StikDebug on iOS 26).
- The *Increased Memory Limit* entitlement is required on all devices; the
  *Extended Virtual Addressing* entitlement is required on iPhones with under
  4 GB RAM and iPads with under 8 GB RAM.
- Sideload with AltStore Classic, SideStore or another Apple ID sideloader.
  AltStore PAL is not supported because the app is not notarized.
- You must supply your own firmware, keys and game dumps. Piracy is not supported.

apps.localizedDescription:
MeloNX enables Nintendo Switch game emulation on iOS, using Ryujinx as a base.

**MeloNX requires JIT** to run. Enable it with your preferred method
(on iOS 26, StikDebug is required).

Notes:
- An *Increased Memory Limit* entitlement is required on all devices, and
  *Extended Virtual Addressing* is required on iPhones under 4 GB RAM and
  iPads under 8 GB RAM. Depending on your sideloading setup you may need a
  paid developer account or TrollStore for these.
- Recommended iPhone: 15 Pro or newer. Recommended iPad: iPad Pro 5th gen
  (8 GB) or iPad Air 5 or newer.
- MeloNX does not ship games, keys or firmware. Dump your own.

Source code: https://starforgejo.dev/projects/MeloNX/releases
Discord: https://discord.gg/HjCDPTpC3W

versions.localizedDescription:
# Highlights
- Ram Limit Workaround using NSExtensions and `xpc_shmem`
    - This does NOT contribute to the in-app "Memory limit tester "
- In-App Controller Remapping
- Controller Navigation 
- (experimental) Steam Controller Support via CoreBluetooth
- iOS 27 AirPlay Support
- Add MetalFX Upscaling

# Full Changelog
## Core & Graphics
- Improved Async Shader Compilation
- NSExtensions and `xpc_shmem` for offloading Guest RAM to NSExtensions, shared mem does not contribute to the main app's `phys_footprint`
- Fix fragment ClipDistance SPIR-V lookup
- Add BCn > ETC2 Texture Recompression for GPUs that do not support BCn
- Memory Pressure GPU Buffer Eviction
- Add MetalFX Spatial Upscaling
- Fix Audio Issues in some games

## UI & Controllers
- Game List Controller Navigation
- Full Controller Remapping
- Fix Opacity with Virtual Controls
- Move Firmware Importing off the Main Thread and Improve Error Reporting
- (experimental) Steam Controller Support via CoreBluetooth
- Anti-Aliasing option added to Settings
- Fix Virtual Controller not disabling when option is enabled.
- Improve Per-Game Settings
- Open Save Folder option
Fix Main Thread Lockups, Joystick not being in the right order, Setup not working.
UI Update, Updated JIT Compiler, Remove Unecessary Dependencies...
Update UpdateAndBindTexturesWithoutTemplate to have the proper UE changes
App Icon Switcher, Per-App Settings Page, Update Virtual Controller and more
Updated JitStreamer Implementation, Reimplemented Texture Chunks, Reworked Alerts and more
Remove func MainThread and add SDL Window code back
